title: ITVX / Icon construction comparison
slide_intent: Compare shape adjustments against a common construction framework, because consistent shapes help small symbols read as one family.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen coherence and legibility in small interface elements.
demonstration: Two black person-like outline icons sit side by side over faint circular and diagonal construction guides. Both use a circular head; the lower contours differ.
practical_value: Compare shape adjustments against a common construction framework.

content_islands.name: Left icon
content_islands.spec: A circular head sits above a more angular torso outline.

content_islands.name: Right icon
content_islands.spec: A circular head sits above a curved upper torso contour.

content_islands.name: Guides
content_islands.spec: Faint geometric lines expose the construction relationship.
